english_description: A large, mature ES II-lineage wuxia MUD -- self-titled Ocean II but far better known in-game by its banner name, Star-Moon Legend (星月传奇) -- sharing engine lineage with this collection's es1_win, xkx2001, rzrmud, xo, Wuhan Station and Legend of the Yellow Emperor's Soul, and one of the more widely-circulated Chinese wuxia MUDs of its era (hymud, “Ocean V,” is its independent successor). Nearly 30,000 files build out a genuinely large world: sect-based jianghu with map regions spanning Jiangnan's water towns, the Mingjiao stronghold, Gaochang, and even a Japan zone, plus a full marriage system and gang/faction play layered on top of the standard skill and quest content. Porting surfaced an unusually deep vein of real bugs for this lineage: a custom ACL daemon that blocked its own compile-time file reads, an intermud DNS lookup reachable from the plain login path that could hang every connection, and a status-check crash on any not-yet-euid'd object (including quest NPCs at creation time) that boot-time NPC spawning could trigger. All fixed and verified live; see NOTES.md for the full catalogue.
